# intn_sale_additional_costs

Parametric configuration for INTN additional expedient costs (fuel, per-diem, admin) and wizard to inject cost lines into sale orders with SIFEN complementary invoicing.

**Grupo:** `intn_sales` · **Versión:** 18.0.2.5.0 · **Categoría:** Sales

**Depende de:** `account`, `base_address_extended`, `fleet`, `intn_portal_registration`, `intn_portal_sale_orders`, `l10n_py_edi_segel`, `l10n_py_ruc`, `mail`, `product`, `sale`, `sale_management`

## Modelos

**Definidos:** `account.move`, `fleet.vehicle`, `intn.admin.cost.type`, `intn.fuel.price`, `intn.fuel.price.history`, `intn.fuel.price.report.wizard`, `intn.travel.zone`, `intn.travel.zone.bulk.toll.wizard`, `sale.additional.cost.line.wizard`, `sale.additional.cost.wizard`, `sale.order`, `sale.order.line`
